questions.prompt: Which beginning-of-construction date should the buyer underwrite?
questions.context: The term sheet assumes construction began in December 2025, but the only support is the transformer manufacturer's own letter and the seller's counsel's statement. The independent engineer reviewed no manufacturer records and dates significant on-site work to January 12, 2026. This date decides whether the 47.8% domestic content result clears the threshold, which is 45% for a 2025 start and 50% for 2026. It also decides whether the foreign entity rules apply, under which the module certification and cost ratio are missing.

evidence.text: On-site physical work of a significant nature, beginning with pile installation for the tracker foundations, commenced on January 12, 2026.
We have not reviewed the manufacturer's records and express no opinion on the tax treatment of off-site work.
Physical manufacture of the transformer, beginning with cutting and stacking of the custom core, commenced at our facility on December 22, 2025 and continued thereafter.
If construction is determined to have begun in 2026, the applicable threshold would be 50% and the Project would not qualify at the computed adjusted percentage.

Also provide the manufacturer's production records showing that core cutting and stacking began on December 22, 2025, evidence that this work was significant and not taken from inventory, and evidence of continuous work since then. Have the independent engineer review these records and give a written opinion on the start date.

The independent engineer reviewed no manufacturer records and dates significant on-site work to January 12, 2026. The construction start year decides the domestic content threshold and whether the foreign entity material assistance rules apply.

risks.title: Insurance excludes the known apprenticeship shortfall
risks.detail: The insurance binder excludes prevailing wage or apprenticeship deficiencies that were known as of binding on September 18, 2026. The labor compliance report dated September 22, 2026 shows that the apprenticeship labor-hour shortfall existed during the period reviewed. If the cure is not made or is ineffective, the resulting loss of the 5x multiplier would likely fall outside the insurance and rest only on the seller and sponsor indemnity.
